'''Moseum''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Moseum system/Legends|Moseum system]] within the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
After being dosed with her own [[Selective memory erasing drug|memory-wiping serum]], [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] believed Moseum to be her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]'' {{1stm}}
